First, note the given date is 1318-08-13 (assuming format MM-DD-YYYY).  

1318 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  

255 days before 1318-08-13:  

1. Go back 31 days to 1318-07-13 (August 13 → July 13).  
   Remaining: 255 - 31 = 224 days.  

2. Go back 30 days to 1318-06-13 (July 13 → June 13).  
   Remaining: 224 - 30 = 194 days.  

3. Go back 31 days to 1318-05-13 (June 13 → May 13).  
   Remaining: 194 - 31 = 163 days.  

4. Go back 30 days to 1318-04-13 (May 13 → April 13).  
   Remaining: 163 - 30 = 133 days.  

5. Go back 31 days to 1318-03-13 (April 13 → March 13).  
   Remaining: 133 - 31 = 102 days.  

6. Go back 28 days (Feb in non-leap year) to 1318-02-13 (March 13 → Feb 13).  
   Remaining: 102 - 28 = 74 days.  

7. Go back 31 days to 1318-01-13 (Feb 13 → Jan 13).  
   Remaining: 74 - 31 = 43 days.  

8. Go back 31 days to 1317-12-13 (Jan 13 → Dec 13 previous year).  
   Remaining: 43 - 31 = 12 days.  

9. Go back 12 days from 1317-12-13 → 1317-12-01.  

Final date: 1317-12-01.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1317-12-01
